decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-a17ed311b248] is a one-line changelog entry. It names the subject (the Argo CD UI log viewer), the change (a new feature that highlights log lines by pod name, so an addition) and gives no operational consequence or environment-specific condition. That is enough to record this as a UI-only, informational addition. The open subject aspect is unfilled because no listed subject family covers a UI feature, not because the evidence is vague. The entry does not say whether highlighting is on by default or controlled by a setting, so this rests only on the title and confidence is low.
